jsonld.name: Acme Sales Agent
jsonld.description: An AI sales agent demo: web research with sourced buying signals, CRM analysis, 0 to 100 lead scores with reasons, and outreach drafts that a person approves before anything is sent.

routes.title: Acme Sales Agent: who to call this week, and what to say
routes.description: An AI sales agent demo for Acme Cloud Security. It researches real companies with sourced buying signals, checks 50 CRM accounts, scores every lead from 0 to 100 and drafts emails that a person approves.

routes.title: Approval queue | Acme Sales Agent
routes.description: Every email the agent writes waits here. Approve it, edit it or reject it with a reason. The app has no way to send email.

routes.title: Researched leads | Acme Sales Agent
routes.description: Real companies found by web research, each with a dated buying signal, a source link and a 0 to 100 score with the reasons behind it.

routes.title: CRM accounts | Acme Sales Agent
routes.description: Fifty mock CRM accounts checked for stalled deals, accounts with no contact for 30 days or more, and likely upsells.

routes.title: Learning from feedback | Acme Sales Agent
routes.description: How reviewer feedback changes the next run: the last 20 approvals, edits and rejections, the rules learned from them, and drafts before and after.

routes.title: Weekly report | Acme Sales Agent
routes.description: The weekly sales report: leads found, emails approved and sent, pipeline at risk and what the agent learned this week.

routes.title: Runs and logs | Acme Sales Agent
routes.description: Every agent run with each tool it called, what came back, tokens and cost, plus the automation log and the Slack alerts.

routes.title: Ideal customer profile | Acme Sales Agent
routes.description: Edit the ideal customer profile the agent scores against, preview how lead scores change and keep a version history.
